name: Prince Charming
vampire_desc: A noble knight. Has nice hair

marks.description: The worlds most perfect(ly sharp) teeth
marks.concealment: I don't really. I smile a LOT.

experiences: A noble knight. Has nice hair

Exposed? What, like naked?
 I guess I leave Camelot behind in shame. I change my name to Mr Charming. I'm sneaky.
He orates a poem to his girl, gwen
Gwen! She find me and discovers my shiny teeth. She helps me murderise. Turns out I do need to do it sometimes. To live, you know.
Who, whoops. Sorry Gwen! I am ashamed. Does this mean she isn't my partner in crime any more?
He uses excalibur to practice his swords
Killed to live in this guys fancy castle. No idea what it's called. I'm gong to call it Castle Charming
He goes to Camelot every day to work for Arthur. Usually to keep the peace. Sometimes to find a missing bloody cup.
No, I refuse to kill anyone. I want to see people die of old age. Whatever bloodthirsty is, I'll slap a patch on for it.
Caught by Connor McCloud of the clan McCloud. Keeps banging on about being the only one. Only one what?
Arthur's bloody kid ran me through, and his sister (?) brings me back? Not sure what's going on there.

resources.name: Partner in crime
resources.description: It's Gwen for now. It might not always be. She's getting on a bit.
